valle.summary: Immerse yourself in a unique volcanic landscape where geological history and the beauty of the moorland create an unforgettable experience.

description.introduction: Explore one of the most amazing landscapes in Los Nevados National Natural Park, where the moorland, volcanoes and geological history come together to offer an unforgettable experience.
description.content: During the trek, you'll traverse volcanic canyons, frailejón fields, and high-mountain trails until you reach the Valley of the Tombs, a lunar-like landscape that reflects the power and constant transformation of nature.
description.conclusion: Ideal for those who enjoy hiking, photography, natural history, and adventures that connect with the essence of the mountains.

1.title: Scenic Route
1.description: Travel along one of the most beautiful roads in Colombia, surrounded by volcanoes, mountains, and natural viewpoints.

2.title: Living Geology
2.description: Explore the Lagunilla Canyon, the Azufrado volcano, and other landscapes shaped by volcanic activity and the history of the Nevado del Ruiz volcano.

3.title: Lunar Landscape
3.description: Discover the Valley of the Tombs, a unique high-mountain environment with panoramic views of the La Olleta and Nevado del Ruiz massifs.

itinerary.1: Meeting at the Espeletia Trips office.
itinerary.4: Visit to Azufrado Canyon and the El Sifón sector.
itinerary.5: Registration and orientation at Los Nevados National Natural Park.
itinerary.6: Hike to Aguacerales, Arenales, and Valle de las Tumbas.
itinerary.7: Return to Murillo, lunch, and end of the experience.

1.description: Get a good night's sleep before your trip and stay hydrated to better enjoy the high-altitude experience.

2.description: Weather in the high mountains can change quickly, so waterproof clothing is essential.

3.title: Respect the páramo
3.description: Always stay on authorized trails and avoid disturbing the ecosystem's flora and fauna.

campanita.summary: Relax in natural hot springs while enjoying the tranquility of the páramo and one of the most special corners of Murillo.

description.introduction: Travel along ancient bridle paths that cross Andean forests and descend to the majestic Recio River Canyon, where nature and rural history meet in a unique setting.
description.content: The hike culminates at the Campanita Hot Springs, a natural refuge where thermal waters spring up in the middle of the mountain. There you can enjoy a relaxing bath and experience contrast therapy by alternating the heat of the hot spring with the cold waters of the river.
description.conclusion: An ideal experience for those looking to connect with nature, discover local history, and enjoy a peaceful tour that combines hiking, wellness, and unforgettable landscapes.

1.title: Hiking with history
1.description: Walk along ancient muleteer trails surrounded by Andean forest and wax palms, following routes full of tradition.

2.title: Natural hot springs
2.description: Relax in hot springs surrounded by a unique mountain environment and enjoy an outdoor wellness experience.

3.title: Rural culture
3.description: Learn about the stories, customs, and memories preserved by the region's inhabitants and their traditional paths.

itinerary.3: Start of the trek along a bridle path to the Recio River Canyon.
itinerary.4: Bath in the Campanita Hot Springs and contrast therapy with the river.
itinerary.6: Traditional local lunch in Murillo and end of the experience.

1.title: Bring a change of clothes
1.description: After the thermal bath, you will appreciate having dry clothes for the return trip.

2.title: Enjoy contrast therapy

3.title: Walk peacefully
3.description: The route does not require speed; take your time to enjoy the forest and landscapes.

canaan.summary: Discover an oasis of natural hot springs surrounded by nature, ideal for disconnecting, resting, and renewing body and mind.

description.introduction: Travel the historic Ruta de la Templanza del Arriero on a 4x4 adventure that combines Andean landscapes, rural tradition, and some of Murillo's most iconic natural settings.
description.content: During the tour you will discover the Abuelo Waterfall, high Andean forests, the emblematic wax palm valley, and the Canaán Hot Springs, a natural oasis where hot waters emerge in the middle of the mountain to offer a space for rest and wellness.
description.conclusion: A perfect experience for those who want to discover the local culture, enjoy nature, and relax in hot springs after a day full of landscapes and stories.

2.title: Nature and heritage

3.title: Canaán Hot Springs

mirador.summary: Take in breathtaking panoramic views of the National Park's volcanoes and mountains from one of the region's most iconic viewpoints

description.introduction: Venture into the Páramo del Oso and discover a route where high Andean forest, frailejones, and water springs lead to one of the most impressive natural viewpoints in Los Nevados National Natural Park.
description.content: Along the trail you will walk through high mountain ecosystems while learning about the importance of the páramo as a source of life. The trek culminates at a natural balcony from where, weather permitting, you can admire Nevado del Ruiz, Santa Isabel, Paramillo del Cisne, and Nevado del Tolima.
description.conclusion: An experience designed for those who enjoy hiking, landscape photography, and the immensity of the Colombian Andes.

1.title: High-altitude trekking
1.description: Trek a 9 km trail through the Páramo del Oso and high Andean forest, surrounded by frailejones and unique landscapes.

2.title: Panoramic view of snow-capped peaks
2.description: Enjoy one of the best natural viewpoints in the region with privileged views of the National Park's main snow-capped mountains.

3.title: The water factory
3.description: Discover sulfur water springs and understand the vital role of the páramo in conserving water resources.

itinerary.1: Meeting and traditional breakfast in Murillo.
itinerary.2: 4x4 vehicle transfer to the Casa Roja sector.
itinerary.3: Start of the trek through páramo and high Andean forest.
itinerary.4: Arrival at Mirador de los Nevados and time for reflection and photography.
itinerary.5: Start of the descent along the same trail.
itinerary.6: Return to Casa Roja and transfer to Murillo.
itinerary.7: Traditional lunch and end of the experience.

1.title: Weather decides
1.description: The best views depend on weather conditions. Be patient and enjoy every moment of the journey.

2.title: Sun protection
2.description: Even if the temperature is low, UV radiation at high altitude is intense. Use sunscreen and UV-filter sunglasses.

3.title: Walk at your own pace
3.description: The altitude can make the exertion feel greater. Keep a steady pace and use breaks to admire the landscape.

oso.summary: Explore ancient trails surrounded by Andean forests, wildlife, and landscapes that preserve the natural essence of the National Park.

description.introduction: Experience a two-day expedition through some of the most remote landscapes of Los Nevados National Natural Park. El Camino del Oso – Mosul crosses páramos, cloud forests, glacial-origin lagoons, and ancient rural routes that keep the essence of the mountain intact.
description.content: The journey traverses high mountain ecosystems until reaching Finca Mosul, where a local farming family opens the doors of their home to share the night, traditional gastronomy, and the stories that have brought life to this territory for generations.
description.conclusion: An experience designed for trekking enthusiasts seeking to disconnect, overcome new challenges, and discover the natural and cultural wealth of Murillo from an authentic perspective.

1.title: Two-day expedition
1.description: Cross páramos, lagoons, cloud forests, and canyons on a trek that combines adventure, nature, and rural culture.

2.title: Rural lodging
2.description: Share a night at Finca Mosul, experiencing firsthand the hospitality, gastronomy, and traditions of a local farming family.

3.title: High mountain landscapes
3.description: Hike among Laguna Verde, El Boquerón, the Blue River Canyon, and natural viewpoints surrounded by the park's most representative ecosystems.

3.title: Day 1 · Afternoon

4.title: Day 1 · Night
4.activity: Arrival at Finca Mosul, traditional dinner, and accommodation in a local farmhouse.

5.title: Day 2 · Morning
5.activity: Breakfast and start of the descent through the cloud forest and the Blue River Canyon.

6.title: Day 2 · Afternoon
6.activity: Arrival at La Estrella hamlet, return to Murillo, and end of the expedition.

nevado.summary: Conquer the snows of Nevado Santa Isabel and live a high-mountain adventure surrounded by glaciers, lagoons, and breathtaking landscapes.

description.introduction: Experience a high-mountain expedition to one of Colombia's last tropical glaciers. Nevado Santa Isabel offers a unique experience for those wishing to challenge their limits and discover the majesty of Los Nevados National Natural Park.
description.content: Over two days, you will hike through páramos, glacial moraines, and high-mountain trails while undergoing an acclimatization process that culminates in the glacier ascent using specialized technical equipment. Every stage is designed to ensure a safe and memorable experience.
description.conclusion: More than reaching a summit, this expedition represents an encounter with the immensity of nature and an opportunity to experience the Colombian high mountains guided by specialized experts.

1.title: Acclimatization at Laguna Verde
1.description: Prepare your body for the altitude by touring one of the park's most iconic landscapes, surrounded by frailejones and páramo ecosystems.

2.title: Glacier ascent
2.description: Use crampons, ice axes, and technical equipment to reach the glacier edge accompanied by certified high-mountain guides.

3.title: Andean panoramas
3.description: From the upper area, contemplate a spectacular horizon dominated by the snow-capped Ruiz, Tolima, El Cisne, and Quindío peaks.

1.title: Day 1 · Morning
1.activity: Departure from Manizales, entry to Los Nevados National Natural Park, and traditional breakfast.

2.title: Day 1 · Mid-morning
2.activity: Acclimatization hike to Laguna Verde del Cisne.

3.title: Day 1 · Afternoon
3.activity: Lunch, technical talk on safety and mountain equipment usage.

4.title: Day 1 · Night
4.activity: Dinner and lodging at El Cisne Mountain Refuge.

5.title: Day 2 · Early Morning
5.activity: Start of the ascent from Conejeras toward the glacier.

6.title: Day 2 · Sunrise
6.activity: Technical gearing up with crampons, ice axe, harness, and ascent to the glacier edge.

7.title: Day 2 · Morning
7.activity: Time for reflection, photography, and controlled descent.

8.title: Day 2 · Afternoon
8.activity: Descent, lunch, and return to Manizales.

1.title: Acclimate properly
1.description: Rest well before the expedition, stay hydrated, and follow the guides' recommendations throughout the entire process.

2.title: Listen to the guides
2.description: Glacier safety depends on teamwork and following technical instructions.

3.title: Respect the glacier
3.description: Nevado Santa Isabel is one of the country's last tropical glaciers. Every visitor shares the responsibility of contributing to its conservation.
